photos.summary: Hero shot of the finished bake — wire rack of 13 cookies plus one mini on a large sheet, warm honey-brown crumb from the browned butter, chocolate chunks visible across the tops. Great Pyrenees and small pup framed in the background of the room.

photos.name: img-8131
photos.summary: Cold-rested dough in a square lidded container on parchment, cookie scoop resting inside — chocolate chunks distributed throughout the tan dough, ready to portion after the overnight fridge rest.

photos.name: img-8136
photos.summary: Close-up of baked cookies on the wire rack — puffed rounds with visibly molten chocolate chip tops and the honey-brown color from the dialed-in brown butter. Pyrenees and second dog blurred behind, second dog mid-lick.

photos.name: img-8140
photos.summary: Rack of finished cookies in the foreground with the Pyrenees watching from across the room — decorative chips visible on top of each cookie, honey-brown crumb, edges set but centers still glossy.
